Contract review take-over — director seat (summon #9, session `session_01WXyGTWPbbreqXow7Z2pZCk`, GitHub `hotlong`), maintainer summon 「项目总监处理契约复审」.

Reading at 09:1xZ: the os-dev report for PR #14395 landed 04:07Z; the `domain:cli` seat post recorded "isolated contract review in progress" at its 04:19Z refresh and has written nothing since (no verdict on this card or on the PR, no seat-post comment after 04:00Z). Five hours with no verdict reads as a stalled carrier, so this seat takes the review now under the director charter's backstop clause. If the cli seat's isolated reviewer is still running, its verdict is welcome and will be reconciled against this one (first verdict on the card stands; a contradicting second one is raised to the maintainer, never silently merged). Verdict follows as the next comment.

## Contract review — PR #14395 @ `4fe663ec90` — **PASS**

Director seat, summon #9, session `session_01WXyGTWPbbreqXow7Z2pZCk`. Tier fuse, both strings verbatim: served `claude-fable-5-1`, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` = `claude-fable-5` (floor reading, named for veto in the round report). Reviewed from the PR diff and the spec source on `origin/main` (`e5812fa`), not from the report. Provenance for clearance: the 2026-08-31 ruling (in-seat / at-tier review clears the label; 清标即落地).

### ① Derived judgments — the accept set moves exactly where the spec already says it does

| change | judged | source read |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `batch.maxBatchSize` outside `1..1000` or non-integer → refused at construction | correct — declared bound, never executed before | `rest-server.zod.ts:369` |
| `routes.nameTransform` outside its enum · `crud.objectParamStyle` outside its enum | correct | `:423` · `:267` |
| `metadata.cacheTtl` non-integer refused; **negative kept** | correct — `.int()` only, no lower bound declared; the card's "negative TTL" guess was wrong and the seam does not invent a rule (bound recorded on #14369) | `:308` |
| `crud.patterns` keyed by a non-CRUD op / non-HTTP method → refused | correct — enum-keyed record validates key by key | `:256` |
| partial `routes.overrides.OBJECT.operations` → refused | correct for today's declaration — `z.record(CrudOperation, z.boolean())` is exhaustive under zod 4 and the input type already demanded all five; see the coupling note below | `:432` |
| unknown keys inside a sub-object stripped, not refused | correct — all four are non-strict `z.object()`; nothing the runtime reads is undeclared | `:241` `:294` `:365` `:407` |
| `openApi31` tombstone left unexecuted | correct — the whole-config schema is deliberately not in the table; flipping #3963's warn-and-ignore posture is a maintainer decision, not this seam's | `:531` |
| parsed output CONSUMED for the four siblings; `api` stays validate-only | correct — per-sub-object key diff is empty and every schema default equals the old `??` literal (`dataPrefix '/data' :262`, `prefix '/meta' :298`, `enableCache true :303`, `enableBatchEndpoint true :375`, `defaultAtomic true :391`, `maxBatchSize 200`, `cacheTtl 3600`, `nameTransform 'none'`, `objectParamStyle 'path'`); `maskObjectFields` (#11983's seat) pinned to survive; `api` folding is #14366 | — |

Refusal text names the sub-object, every failing key, zod's issue text and the declaring schema; the `api.version` mount rationale is not inherited by sibling refusals (pinned). `assertDeclaredApiConfig` keeps #11637's exact message through the shared `parseDeclaredSubConfig`, and #11637's own pin file stays green (45/45).

Blast radius as measured in the PR (0 in-repo construction sites pass any of the four sub-objects; 3 out-of-range literals all in schema tests or a different schema's key; full `@objectstack/rest` suite 168 files / 2828 tests green): accepted. An external deployment carrying an out-of-range value now fails at construction with a named fix — the same shape #11637 and #12450 shipped on this door.

### ② semver

`.changeset/rest-sub-configs-parsed-not-cast.md` — `@objectstack/rest: minor`, **BREAKING (accept-set tightening)**, refused and deliberately-kept shapes enumerated, `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. Matches the launch-window convention (`check-changeset-no-major`) and the two precedents on this door. ✓

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions: []`. Three out-of-scope cards filed by the dev (#14365 · #14366 · #14369) — all exist, unassigned. ✓

### Coupling recorded (not a defect)

§A pin *"refuses a partial `routes.overrides.OBJECT.operations`"* in `packages/rest/src/rest-sub-config-parse-not-cast.test.ts` pins **today's** declaration. #14365 proposes `z.partialRecord` for that record; if the spec seat takes that half, this pin goes RED on their branch by design. Flip rule for #14365's implementer: **delete or reverse the pin, never fix it green.** Noted on #14365 in this stroke. The §D `patterns` pin is contract-stable under either declaration, as the PR body says.

### Landing

Paths: `packages/rest/src/**`, one changeset, `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` (generated census page, regenerated by its own gate) → no governed surface → 清标即落地: `needs:contract-review` stripped on PR and card in the same stroke (read-modify-write, read back), PR → ready, auto-merge armed, followed to MERGED by this seat. CI at head: 37 check runs, every one `success` or `skipped`, zero red.
